title: dfmcp.replay.bundle/3
description: A bounded private laboratory engine transcript with explicit semantic tool-result coverage. Every tool entry retains outcome, canonical anchor and request frontier, and adds a closed result_commitment. Eligible results use dfmcp.replay.tool-payload/1; unsupported results explicitly use dfmcp.replay.outcome-anchor/1 and do not claim payload equality. The replayer recomputes the whole commitment, including its profile, so an edited weaker profile cannot silently disable comparison. Task drain entries preserve the unchanged /2 engine event contract, without reconstructing Task identities/lifecycle. calls_digest = SHA-256("dfmcp-replay-bundle-calls/3\0" || compact canonical JSON of calls). The complete envelope, entry shapes and commitment profiles are validated before opening a fresh session. Readers retain /1 and /2 comparison semantics and exact legacy re-export; new captures use /3. No transcript or result digest grants authority or proves native effects.

counter.description: Canonical decimal u128 request counter; reader additionally enforces the exact u128 maximum.

authority_digest.description: SHA-256 of dfmcp-task-replay-authority/1 NUL followed by the ordered current grants, risks, scopes, expiries and remaining uses in compact canonical JSON.

original_actions_digest.description: SHA-256 of dfmcp-task-replay-original-actions/1 NUL and complete retained original selector, receipt/evidence/physical-work/lease census (at most 64 actions), or exact unavailable-custody diagnostic.

evidence_digest.description: SHA-256 of dfmcp-task-replay-evidence/1 NUL and the full typed drain outcome. Five documented direct current-owner paths are normalized. A nested withdrawal proof additionally requires exact verified retained source, terminal census and quiet-frontier custody before its owner/requester inputs are normalized and resealed. A valid local finalization certificate is then rederived from the same normalized material; invalid identities stay distinguishable. Error records retain failure code and message; after witnesses retain partial effects.

result_commitment.description: dfmcp.replay.tool-payload/1 hashes SHA-256("dfmcp-replay-tool-payload/1\0" || compact canonical JSON of {tool,result:<normalized final rendered root tool payload>}). Every object is sorted by key; array order and primitive JSON values are retained. Eligible tools are observe, plan, doctor, numeric entity explain, and query summary/entities/observation/terrain/path/search/structured. Other tools and query modes are explicit outcome-only. Opaque structured result continuation strings, nonempty retained query work catalogs, and non-null observation objective withdrawals are outcome-only. The profile excludes the entire root agent_turn presentation packet. It tags unsigned values only at /query_budget/max_wall_millis, /output_budget/full_estimate_tokens, and doctor /active_sessions_count; missing fields, malformed values, semantic truncation tiers, coverage, source accounting and negotiated limits remain distinguishable. Only the known full/compact_turn tier pair is tagged as tool_payload_intact, because it changes presentation without changing tool data. Entries under output_budget.minimal_truncated whose dotted path begins agent_turn. are outside this profile; an emptied map produced by removing those entries is omitted. Other omission metadata remains committed. Exact current-owner strings are tagged only at /session_id and observe /objectives/*/owner_session_id and /objectives/*/continuation_request/arguments/session_id. For query result mode entities, only /rows/*/resource_uri with the exact df://session/<current-owner>/entity- prefix is normalized; the entire identity/generation/anchor suffix remains committed. Non-owner values at these paths are retained as tagged literal values; arbitrary nested user fields are not rewritten. Accepted source payloads are JSON objects of at most 1048576 UTF-8 bytes, 65536 value nodes and depth 64. This profile verifies delivered data and error details within its declared scope, not Agent Turn fidelity, opaque process handles, or omitted result content.
